Soy Ram, estudiante de Ingeniería en Gestión Empresarial

Elegí el reto "Abandonado pero no Olvidados" porque no solo es contar qué dejó la NASA en la Luna y Marte, es darle voz a esos objetos que hicieron historia.

Mis intereses: Me encanta el storytelling, el diseño y cómo la tecnología cuenta historias. 

Mis habilidades:

- Organización de equipos y liderazgo de proyectos

- Investigación y narrativa / guionismo

- Diseño básico, presentaciones y redes
summary:
I developed "Lost Explorers" (Eros & Friends), a bilingual (Spanish/English) educational and interactive web platform aimed at children aged 5 to 12, featuring an illustrated 5-chapter digital book and a gallery of historical space missions.
To address the challenge of explaining complex astronomical concepts to children, the project transforms the fate of real missions—such as the NEAR Shoemaker probe on the asteroid 433 Eros—into a tender fictional narrative starring an endearing character named Fofi. All of this is integrated with customizable read-aloud tools and interactive technical fact sheets.
Its importance lies in democratizing scientific and space outreach, successfully sparking curiosity and interest in STEAM disciplines (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics) from an early age through emotion, art, and literature.
details:
• What does it do or how does it work? It is an educational and interactive bilingual web platform (Spanish/English) aimed at children aged 5 to 12. It features an interactive 5-chapter digital story viewer that narrates the adventure of the real space probe NEAR Shoemaker and a cute alien named Fofi on the asteroid 433 Eros. It includes real-time voice narration controls (speechSynthesis), speed and pitch selectors, original vector illustrations, a gallery of "Space Missions Without Return" with pop-up technical fact sheets, and a section with cosmic fun facts.
    • Accessible scientific outreach: Translates complex concepts of unmanned space missions, orbits, and celestial bodies into an empathetic and easy-to-understand narrative for children.
    • Fostering reading and STEAM learning: Stimulates curiosity about science and technology by combining literature, visual art, and astronomy.
    • Inclusion and accessibility: Being bilingual and featuring customizable read-aloud tools, it facilitates auditory and language learning.
    • Programming languages: HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript.
    • Browser technologies and APIs: Native browser speech synthesis API (window.speechSynthesis) for assisted story reading.
    • Design and Style: Embedded SVG icons and vector graphics, clean typography, and responsive design for various devices (computers, tablets, and mobile phones).
    • The target audience (5 to 12 years old): Designed an intuitive interface with friendly space colors, rounded corners, legible typography, and texts structured into short chapters to maintain children's attention.
    • The interactive user experience: Incorporated dynamic elements (navigation buttons, hover effects, informative modals, and dynamic language switching) to make exploration fun.
    • Technical accessibility: Prioritized development in a single, clean, self-contained web file, avoiding heavy external dependencies to ensure fast loading and smooth performance on any device.
